findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: leakdata.search, leakdata.password_prefix_check · Private data: leakdata.search, leakdata.password_prefix_check · Public sink: leakdata.search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: leakdata.search, leakdata.password_prefix_check · Private data: leakdata.search, leakdata.password_prefix_check · Public sink: leakdata.search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
